text_block_list.name: Копано Рики
text_block_list.text:
This red bean paste is super delish! It's<n>like I'm
fully recharged of my Copa<n>energy! ☆ Where did
you buy this stuff,<n>Acute?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you like it! I got it across the<n>street from
the greengrocer down the<n>road.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Delicious! ♪ This sweetness is recharging<n>my Taru
energy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Копано Рики
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Is that idol mode I hear?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's time for a taruific Tomakomaiintroduction! ☆ Or something like that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, are you trying to imitate Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickeynese is surprisingly full of tips on<n>how to
sell a personality...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: This taiyaki really is a cutie! ♪ Hehe,well I admit this is quite fun.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hokko ☆ hokkori ☆ Hokkaido! ☆ Hmm...<n>Perhaps
it could use a bit more<n>workshopping.

text_block_list.name: Копано Рики
text_block_list.text:
Well, it wasn't a bad start. I'll let you<n>take it.
Rickey ☆ lucky ☆ fine by me! ☆
